committee_name.text: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee (referred to in the Office Director memo as the Cardio-Renal Advisory Committee)

quote.quote: We presented ticagrelor at the July 28, 2010, meeting of the Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee.
The ticagrelor NDA was presented to the Cardio-Renal Advisory Committee on July 28, 2010.

recommendation.text: The committee voted 7-1 recommending approval of ticagrelor for ACS (for both invasive and medical management).

quote.quote: By a 7-1 vote the committee recommended approval.

summary: The Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee met on July 28, 2010 and voted 7-1 to recommend approval of ticagrelor (Brilinta) for ACS, concluding that the troubling US/OUS efficacy disparity was most likely due to chance and not a deterrent to approval. The reviews report that the committee did not tie its endorsement to any specific required change: the ODMemo states the AC had 'relatively little discussion of the aspirin dosing results and no strong recommendation' on aspirin dose, so the eventual Boxed Warning limiting aspirin maintenance dose to <=100 mg was an FDA/review-team decision rather than an AdComm-driven change, and the committee's expressed wish for a follow-on US confirmatory study did not become a required study prior to approval. No AdComm concern is explicitly tied by the review documents to a resulting change in the application, so no linkages are reported.
